scope: Advanced preview-only re-audit against prior production evidence

comparison.before: Unknown production URL returned 200 and showed an unstyled client 404.
comparison.now: Static branded /404.html exists; rendered unknown page has noindex and no canonical. The preview still returns 200/homepage HTML for unknown paths.
comparison.next: Retest the final production hosting rule after deployment; preview behavior cannot confirm Netlify behavior.

comparison.finding: Duplicate/conflicting description, canonical and robots tags
comparison.before: Homepage had two descriptions/two canonicals; error route had conflicting index/noindex and canonicals.
comparison.now: Homepage has one description/canonical/robots tag; rendered error has one error description, no canonical and one noindex. A separate residual social-description issue is recorded below.
comparison.next: Verify the same tag counts on production after publishing.

comparison.result: Served assets fixed; automation not verified
comparison.before: 500px and 337px PNGs totaling 171,528 bytes displayed at 44px.
comparison.now: Both are 132px; 9,227 + 16,957 = 26,184 bytes, 84.73% smaller. Both load at 44px on desktop/mobile.
comparison.next: Confirm a repeatable optimization workflow in the updated source.

comparison.finding: Structured job-title mismatch and unverified profile date
comparison.before: Person.jobTitle said Associate Software Engineer while current visible role said Software Engineer.
comparison.now: Person.jobTitle is Software Engineer, matching the current visible role. ProfilePage no longer emits the unverified dateCreated. Historical Associate roles remain valid history, not a conflict.
comparison.next: Validate final structured data on production; do not reintroduce unverified dates.

comparison.result: Better lab observation; field outcome unverified
comparison.before: One cold desktop LCP was 4.636 s; the baseline mobile sample used a warm cache.
comparison.now: Cache-disabled preview samples: desktop 1.328 s/CLS 0.0136; mobile 0.764 s/CLS 0.0159. Different hosting, time and measurement conditions prevent code-only attribution. No INP/field percentile is available.
comparison.next: Run repeated controlled tests and review field data after production deployment.

comparison.result: Fixed on preview; production asset check pending
comparison.before: summary_large_image was declared with no og:image/twitter:image.
comparison.now: Both image tags exist with alt/dimensions. Preview image returns 200 image/png, 1200x630, 220,012 bytes. Tags intentionally advertise the production asset URL.
comparison.next: Ensure the advertised rusiru.cc image URL returns the new PNG after release.

comparison.now: Only preview HTTP-to-HTTPS was checked (one 301). No claim is made about the new production chain.
comparison.next: Check apex/www HTTP/HTTPS variants on the final host after release.

remaining_findings.title: Unknown paths still return 200 on the preview host
remaining_findings.evidence: evidence/http-evidence.json: missing status 200; missing.html has homepage title/index,follow; browser-evidence.json later shows a noindex 404 UI.
remaining_findings.action: Verify static 404 generation and final hosting configuration together after deployment. Do not mark server response behavior fixed solely because /404.html exists.

remaining_findings.title: Rendered error social descriptions retain homepage copy
remaining_findings.evidence: missing-rendered og:title/twitter:title correctly become Page Not Found, but og:description and twitter:description still describe the portfolio. The direct static 404 document has correct error descriptions.
remaining_findings.action: Make the dynamic error head use the localized error descriptions too, then check direct navigation and client navigation.

remaining_findings.title: Social description punctuation is garbled
remaining_findings.evidence: Browser OG/Twitter description contains Unicode U+00E2 U+20AC U+201D where an em dash is intended. The same mojibake occurs in baseline evidence, so this is newly noticed, not a proven new regression.
remaining_findings.action: Correct the source description string with proper UTF-8 punctuation and regenerate; raw response is valid UTF-8, so changing HTTP charset alone will not repair it.

source_provenance.local_source_status: Older than the preview; no pull, reset or source mutation was performed.

raw_scanner.caveat: Includes raw templates, the design prototype and a prior audit HTML artifact. These warnings do not establish defects in the deployed preview.

limitations: Preview only: rusiru.cc and its www variants were not refetched. No fixes are claimed live in production.
The intended production canonical, sitemap locations and share-image URLs remain on rusiru.cc. Cross-host canonical references are expected here, not automatic defects.
The 200-page advanced cap discovered one same-host HTML page. Nine supplemental HTTP endpoints, three browser states and one preview image were checked.

Preview robots.txt permits crawling and its homepage is index,follow. A production canonical is a hint, not a preview access control. Decide preview indexation policy separately; do not accidentally add production noindex.
Local source is behind deployed preview commit 720795a3764bb2012d5d1dab5f5a0540685b14aa. New fix verification relies on preview HTTP/browser evidence, not stale source line assumptions.
No GSC, Bing, GA4, search-performance, backlink, keyword, competitor or AI-visibility evidence was supplied. Those account-dependent checks remain untested.

Lab LCP/CLS are single unthrottled cache-disabled observations. No Lighthouse score, INP measurement or real-user CWV pass/fail is reported. Cross-host before/after timing is not a controlled experiment.

The packaged auditor still emits all 54 statuses as Not tested because it compares string CSV IDs with integers; raw files are preserved. The reviewed checklist is the authoritative human-reviewed result for this recheck.
No source edits, automatic fixes, commits, deployment or account changes were made. proposed_fixes.patch is empty; no rollback is needed.
